show.description: Ishika is a talented and ambitious chef who marries a man she has never met. Months later, she is selected for a cooking reality show, where she comes face to face with celebrity chef Abhay Rajput After eliminating her from the show, Abhay offers Ishika a job at his restaurant. Gradually, Ishika discovers that Abhay is not only her boss, but also her husband—setting the stage for a complex story of power, ego, trust, and growing passion.
